philosophy: Crafting is tertiary. Scavenging is the core loop. 8 recipes, 1-2 ingredients each, no stations except a lit campfire (a placed object, not a workbench). No trees, no tiers, no unlocks. Clothing, guns, ammo, food, meds and purification tablets come from loot only.

units.time_real_seconds: real seconds the craft takes (player can be interrupted; inputs are consumed on completion)

requires_values.near_campfire: within 2.5 m of a lit campfire or burn_barrel

recipes.name: Build campfire

rules.late_summer_note: Allowed in late summer but raises hydration drain and heat stress nearby; mainly for boiling and light. Heat draws Tallmen/assimilated animals in Act III.

recipes.legacy: config RECIPES campfire_kit used wood 3 + scrap 1; cloth is the tinder now so scrap stays a repair material

recipes.name: Molotov
recipes.legacy: config RECIPES molotov (needs an empty bottle in fiction; bottle is assumed)

recipes.name: Patch clothing
recipes.note: Clothing below 25% durability loses half its insulation; patching is how you keep a good coat.

recipes.name: Fix melee weapon
recipes.note: Melee only. Guns need a looted repair_kit.

recipes.name: Boil water
recipes.note: Removes sickness only (not hot-spring minerals); in nuclear_winter fallout remains. purification_tablets (loot) clean fully. Sources: Truckee River, Sparks Marina, irrigation ditches, rain barrels, melted snow (winter).

removed_from_config_js.reason: mask_filter is loot-only (scarce Act IV resource).

story_recipes_note: Revision 2 has no story crafting recipes (gameplay_hooks chapters have no 'crafting' entries). The v1 one-off recipe was removed with the medical mechanic.

story_interactives.note: Level interactive from gameplay_hooks ch01 (repurposed v1 station). Not a menu recipe; doesn't count toward the 8.
